cs_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The SPI chip-select pin connected to the LED-driver board.

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

data_rate.docs:
**frequency**: The SPI data rate. Defaults to `8MHz`.

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

model.docs:
**enum**: The Pixoo panel model. Currently only `64x64` is supported. Defaults to `64x64`.

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the display. See [Display Rendering Engine](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-engine) for more information.

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

pages.docs:
**list**: Show pages instead of a single lambda. See [Display Pages](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-pages).

*See also: [Divoom Pixoo Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/pixoo#configuration-variables)*

pixoo_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the `pixoo` display to control. Automatically set when only one `pixoo` display is configured; required when there is more than one.

*See also: [Pixoo Brightness](https://esphome.io/components/light/pixoo#configuration-variables)*
